# sidequest

> An open, curated directory of things worth remembering: developer and AI tools, GitHub repos,
> articles, books, courses, communities, remote job boards, referral links, and a directory of
> notable tech companies organised by country.

sidequest is a static site generated from flat YAML files in a public git repository. There is no
database and no user accounts. Every entry is a single YAML file, so the underlying data is easy
to read, fork, and reuse.

## Data model

Two entity types, with separate schemas:

- **Links** (`data/links/<category>/<slug>.yaml`) - any saved resource. Required fields: url,
  title, category, tags, priority (high|medium|low), date_added, source. Optional: note,
  description, added_by, alternatives, audience.
- **Companies** (`data/companies/<country>/<slug>.yaml`) - tech companies worth knowing about.
  Required: name, website, country, industry, date_added, source. Optional: careers_url,
  hiring_status, size, rating, tags, remote_policy.

Categories live in an open registry (`taxonomy/categories.yaml`) rather than a fixed enum, so the
taxonomy grows with the directory. Tags are free-form. Entry counts are computed, never stored.

The `alternatives` field is declared one-way but presented both ways: if entry A lists B as an
alternative, B's page also shows A.

## Machine-readable access

- Full dataset as JSON: https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/api/entries.json
- Sitemap: https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Source of truth (YAML + JSON Schema): https://github.com/ibtisam-iq/sidequest

## Key pages

- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/ - overview, categories, recent and top entries
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/links - all links, filterable by category, priority, audience, tag
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/companies - company directory, filterable by country, industry,
  hiring status, remote policy and size
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/search - full-text search
